query:
SELECT lc.contaCustoId, cc.nome as contaNome, SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_custo lc
LEFT JOIN conta_custo cc ON cc.id = lc.contaCustoId
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY lc.contaCustoId, cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
